final: WITH s1 AS (SELECT observstation, COUNT(*) AS c FROM telescopes GROUP BY observstation), s2 AS (SELECT SUM(c) AS total FROM s1), s3 AS (SELECT s1.observstation AS o, s1.c AS c, CAST(s1.c AS REAL) / NULLIF(s2.total, 0) AS share FROM s1 JOIN s2 ON s2.total IS NOT NULL), s4 AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS a FROM s3), s5 AS (SELECT s3.o, s3.c, s3.share, s3.share - s4.a AS diff FROM s3 JOIN s4 ON s4.a IS NOT NULL WHERE s3.share > s4.a) SELECT AVG(c), AVG(share), AVG(diff) FROM s5
